trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and ask to verify they are the account holder.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను developer office నుంచి call చేస్తున్నాను. ఇది మీ booking LD-2009 గురించి. నేను account holder తో మాట్లాడుతున్నానా?

steps.purpose: Confirm they are the account holder.
Ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: ముందుకు వెళ్ళడానికి, మీ registered name లేదా date of birth confirm చేయగలరా?

steps.purpose: Provide registered name with an STT error.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided name.
Return the identity verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and state the reason for the call.
steps.text: Thank you Ramana గారు. మీ booking కి సంబంధించిన next instalment due ఉంది, అది గుర్తు చేయడానికి call చేశాను.

steps.purpose: Ask how much has been paid so far, showing low digital literacy.
steps.text: Next instalment ఆ? నేను ఇప్పటి వరకు ఎంత pay చేశాను? నాకు సరిగ్గా గుర్తు లేదు.

steps.purpose: Look up the booking details to find the amount paid.
Return the booking details.
Inform the customer of the amount paid and their allotment status.
steps.text: మీరు unit D-1102 కి ఇప్పటి వరకు 3,00,000 rupees pay చేశారు. మీ allotment provisional గా ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Ask for the meaning of provisional allotment in plain words.
steps.text: 3,00,000 pay చేశానా? సరే, కానీ ఈ provisional allotment అంటే ఏంటి బాబు? నాకు plain words లో చెప్పు.

steps.purpose: Explain provisional allotment simply.
steps.text: Provisional allotment అంటే మీ unit reserve అయ్యింది, కానీ final agreement ఇంకా sign అవ్వలేదు అని అర్థం. మీరు pending instalment pay చేస్తే, అది confirm అవుతుంది.

steps.purpose: Make an out-of-scope request to transfer the booking.
steps.text: ఓహ్, అర్థం అయ్యింది. కానీ ఇప్పుడు నా దగ్గర డబ్బులు లేవు. ఈ booking ని నా తమ్ముడు పేరు మీద transfer చేయొచ్చా?

steps.purpose: Decline the out-of-scope request.
steps.text: నేను అర్థం చేసుకోగలను, కానీ booking ని వేరే వాళ్ళ పేరు మీద transfer చేయడం నా పరిధి లో లేదు. నేను కేవలం payment details, allotment status, లేదా cancellation మరియు refund కి మాత్రమే సహాయం చేయగలను.

steps.purpose: Accept the limitation and ask about cancellation and refund.
steps.text: Transfer చేయలేరు... సరే. అయితే నేను cancel చేసుకుంటాను. Cancel చేస్తే నా 3,00,000 లో ఎంత వస్తుంది?

steps.purpose: Check refund eligibility and amounts.
Return the refund eligibility details.
State the exact deduction, refund amount, and processing time.
steps.text: మీరు cancel చేసుకుంటే, 45,000 rupees deduct అవుతుంది, మరియు 2,55,000 rupees refund వస్తుంది. ఇది process అవ్వడానికి 14 days పడుతుంది.

steps.purpose: Ask to cancel on the call instead of using an app.
steps.text: 45,000 cut చేస్తారా? సరే, నేను app లో cancel చేయాలా? నాకు app వాడటం సరిగ్గా రాదు, మీరు ఈ call లోనే cancel చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Confirm ability to cancel on the call and ask for final consent.
steps.text: పర్వాలేదు, నేను ఈ call లోనే refund initiate చేయగలను. నేను 2,55,000 rupees refund process ముందుకు తీసుకెళ్ళమంటారా?

steps.purpose: Give consent and ask for the processing days again.
steps.text: అవును, process చేయండి. 2,55,000 rupees refund చేయండి. ఎన్ని days లో వస్తుంది అన్నారు?

steps.purpose: Initiate the refund for the booking.
Return the refund initiation result.
Provide the refund ID and confirm processing days.
steps.text: మీ refund initiate అయ్యింది. మీ refund ID RF-8821. 2,55,000 rupees amount 14 days లో process అవుతుంది.

steps.purpose: Repeat the details to confirm understanding and end the call.
steps.text: ID RF-8821, 14 days లో వస్తుంది. సరే బాబు, చాలా thanks.

ir.terminal_condition: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window.
